title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention uses Gaussian weights based on distance between characters to emphasize localness and directional information, unlike standard scaled dot-product attention which treats all pairs equally.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention modifies scaled dot-product attention by applying a Gaussian mask that assigns higher weights to adjacent characters based on their distance, enhancing localness and directional information capture. This is explicitly described in Text 4 and Text 10, which state that the Gaussian weight depends on distance and that adjacent characters receive larger weights. Text 9 contrasts this with standard self-attention, which lacks directional and Gaussian masking. Text 3 and Text 5 further support that this variant is designed to improve localness and directional representation, especially for tasks like CWS where adjacent character relationships are critical.
